title: Sr. Software Development Manager, Computer Backup
description:
About Backblaze  

Backblaze provides reliable, high-availability cloud storage and backup trusted by consumers, SMBs, enterprises, and developers in over 150 countries. Backblaze Computer Backup protects the data of hundreds of thousands of customers, backing up laptops and desktops across Windows and macOS to the Backblaze cloud. We build durable, scalable systems with a strong emphasis on reliability, product quality, and a great customer experience. 

Role Overview  

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the team responsible for Backblaze Computer Backup, spanning both the cross-platform desktop client and the backend services that receive, store, and restore customer data. The entire Computer Backup engineering team reports into this role, which you will run through Desktop and Backend Leads who own the day-to-day of their areas. You will set the long-term technical direction for the product, own its multi-quarter delivery strategy, and hold accountability for the team’s budget and results.

This is a hands-on management role. You will take part in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical decisions across both the desktop and backend sides of the product, while also owning strategy, budget, and the growth of your staff. The right candidate brings strong experience running agile teams, experience managing managers or team leads, deep expertise in system architecture, and a track record of leading distributed, remote-first
engineering teams. You bring 7+ years of engineering management experience and enthusiasm for how AI-assisted development is changing the way software gets built.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Lead the full Computer Backup engineering team, which reports into this role, with Desktop and Backend Leads running the day-to-day of their areas.

• Set the long-term technical direction for Computer Backup, ensuring architecture and platform decisions hold up as the product and customer base grow.

• Own the multi-quarter delivery strategy for Computer Backup, and partner with Product leadership to help set the roadmap and negotiate scope, schedule, and priorities.

• Hold accountability for the team’s budget and spend, aligning headcount, tooling, and infrastructure investment with business priorities.

• Make technical and organizational decisions with broad, long-term impact, including shared platform components and infrastructure that other teams depend on.

• Ensure the desktop and backend areas operate well together, with shared goals and a consistent agile delivery process.

• Provide oversight of the team’s agile process, ensuring ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, and retrospectives are run well and consistently across both areas.

• Own delivery across the client and backend, from planning and design through implementation and post-launch support, partnering with dedicated QA and release teams for testing and delivery.

• Ensure the reliability, performance, and maintainability of the backup client and backend services that customers depend on to protect their data.

• Champion engineering quality by growing unit testing and other automated test coverage, and by keeping testing a first-class part of how the team builds and ships software.

• Take part hands-on in code reviews, architecture decisions, and technical problem-solving across both desktop and server work.

• Champion the effective use of AI-assisted development tools, guide the team in adopting agentic coding practices, and help establish norms around AI-augmented workflows.

• Continuously improve team productivity by identifying bottlenecks, refining processes, and investing in tooling and practices that help engineers do their best work.

• Negotiate directly with senior leadership and major customers on significant matters, represent the team in executive reviews, and communicate risks and trade-offs wi

title: Account Executive, Partnerships – SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the Team

The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border banking, spend management, and FX operations. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.

What You’ll Do

Airwallex is seeking an experienced Account Executive - Partnerships to join our UK GTM Partnerships team. This role offers a key opportunity to drive our UK market expansion, specifically focusing on partner-referred businesses requiring global financial accounts, spend management tools, and payment processing. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in B2B financial services or fintech, with demonstrable experience partnering with growing businesses.

We are looking for individuals who are driven by customer success, have a solutions-oriented mindset, and possess an insatiable curiosity for innovation in financial technology. This position is critical in driving our growth and establishing Airwallex as the go-to financial partner for expanding SMEs. You will work closely with our UKI GTM Partnerships team to convert high‑intent referrals from our partner ecosystem into active, thriving accounts through consultative selling, negotiation, and cross-functional alignment.

This role operates in a hybrid work environment (minimum 3 days per week in our London office).

Responsibilities

- Product Mastery: Develop deep product expertise across Airwallex’s platform, including multi-currency business accounts, global transfers, corporate cards, and treasury management.

- Full Sales Lifecycle: Own the end-to-end sales cycle for partner-referred leads, from initial qualification and compelling presentations to closing and initial client onboarding.

- Partner & Channel Collaboration: Act as a main point of contact for partners, clearly communicating Airwallex’s value proposition and nurturing strong referral relationships, collaborating closely with GTM Partner Managers

- Strengthen Partner Relationships: Work proactively and collaborate with Airwallex partners as a core stakeholder in deals.

- Discovery & Consultation: Lead consultative discovery sessions with prospective clients to understand their financial setup, international business friction, and operational pain points to recommend tailored Airwallex solutions.

- Contracting & Closing: Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and revenue operations teams to negotiate and execute commercial agreements.

- Revenue Target Achievement: Exceed revenue and account activation targets through effective value-based selling.

- Process Improvement

title: Head of Events, Works in Progress
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Works in Progress is Stripe's magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture, published online and in print. We have a fast-growing global audience, primarily in tech, finance and politics, and we are building out the team across editorial, design, operations and commercial.

What you’ll do

You will build and run a commercial Works in Progress events program, focusing on the US. You will design events that people want to attend and that you can sell and grow sponsorship for. You will identify sponsors and partners, approach and pitch to them, and be responsible for meeting pre-agreed revenue and audience targets.

We currently offer infrequent events as one of the perks of being a subscriber to the magazine. Our existing community events program includes subscriber events in cities all over the world, particularly San Francisco; New York; Washington, DC; London; Dublin; and Brussels. 

You will assess where there are opportunities to raise revenue from our existing pipeline of events or by repeating existing formats, identify which events should be retired, and design new formats of events with commercial potential.

You will have the freedom to design your own events program, which may include a flagship annual summit, salons, themed dinners and lectures. Our events should appeal to ambitious people who are curious about the world. The Works in Progress editorial and operations teams will support you on programming: you will recommend speakers and formats, and we will sign them off. You do not need to arrive already knowing our taste - we will give you clear guidelines to work with. What matters most is commercial drive, energy and excellent production.

You'll have the budget to add two more people to your team, plus contractors and agencies where needed.

Responsibilities

• Design a model for US events, including sponsorship, ticketing, partnerships and invites

• Set events strategy and build an events calendar

• Own the events P&L and set and hit revenue targets

• Sell and manage sponsorships, and build relationships with sponsors across energy, housing, science, culture, economics and other core Works in Progress topics

• Lead events end to end from concept to on-site delivery

• Work with the editorial and operations teams to identify the right ideas and people for live events, and build guest lists with genuine influence

• Manage budgets, vendors, venues, production partners and timelines

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Experience launching or substantially expanding a commercial events program, including developing its commercial model, operating plan, and performance measures

• A proven record selling and closing event sponsorship and hitting revenue targets

• Based in, or able to be based in, New York or San Francisco, with regular travel

Preferred qualifications

• Events experience at a media company

• Experience building commercially successful events for a high-value audience, not just a large one

• Existing relationships with sponsors and brands, and with the kind of people we want on our guest lists

• Be an exist

Overview
Cayuse Language Connect, LLC, is seeking a skilled and dedicated American Sign Language (ASL) Interpreter to provide high-quality ASL interpretation services to support effective communication between Deaf and hearing individuals. The ideal candidate will interpret scenarios across diverse fields such as education, legal, medical, environmental, and social services, ensuring accessibility, professionalism, and adherence to ethical standards.
The position performs all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the Mission, Vision, and Core Values of Cayuse.
Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities

• Provide accurate ASL-to-English and English-to-ASL interpretation for one-on-one interactions, group settings, and virtual or in-person meetings.

• Facilitate communication in a variety of settings, including but not limited to education, healthcare, legal proceedings, and community services.

• Utilize Video Remote Interpreting (VRI) and other technologies to deliver high-quality remote interpretation services when required.

• Maintain strict confidentiality and adherence to ethical standards outlined by the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (RID Code of Professional Conduct).

• Work collaboratively with Deaf individuals, colleagues, and organizational personnel to deliver seamless communication.

• Perform other language support tasks as assigned.

Qualifications
Qualifications - Here’s What You Need

• Minimum 5+ years of professional ASL interpreting experience in one or more relevant fields (e.g., education, medical, community, or legal).

• Bachelor’s Degree in American Sign Language (ASL), Linguistics, Deaf Studies, or a related field is strongly preferred.

• Must hold one or more of the following professional certifications:

• Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (RID) certification.

• Board for Evaluation of Interpreters (BEI) certification.

• Certified Deaf Interpreter (CDI) certification, or equivalent.

Minimum Skills

• Fluency in ASL and English, with exceptional comprehension, vocabulary, and cultural awareness.

• Thorough understanding of the Deaf culture, and the ability to engage with the Deaf community effectively and respectfully.

• Strong ability to manage complex or sensitive communication exchanges with professionalism, discretion, and empathy.

• Physical stamina and mental focus for extended interpreting sessions in both remote and in-person environments.

• Outstanding interpersonal skills, social awareness, and sensitivity to cultural nuances.

• Familiarity with virtual interpreting platforms (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or VRI tools) for remote assignments.

• Must pass a background check and comply with additional client or project-specific screenings during employment as required.

• Travel availability to support on-site assignments when needed.

Desired Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in American Sign Language (ASL), Linguistics, Deaf Studies, or a related field is strongly preferred.

• Experience interpreting in high-profile or specialized fields (e.g., federal courts, higher education, or corporate environments).

• Knowledge of tactile interpreting (e.g., for Deaf-Blind clients).

• Fluency in an additional spoken language (e.g., Spanish, French, Mandarin) alongside ASL.

Reports to: Deputy Program Manager
Working Conditions

• Must be able to be on-call, Interpreter will be notified within 48 hours of potential jobs.

• Must be physically and mentally able to perform duties extended periods of time.

• Ability to use a computer and other office productivity tools with sufficient speed to meet the demands of this position.

• Must be able to establish a productive and professional workspace.

• Must be able to sit or stand for long periods of time looking at computer screen.

• May be asked to work a flexible schedule which may include holidays.

• May be asked to work hours outside of normal business hours.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Analista Financeiro, Legal Efficiency (Vaga afirmativa para PcD)
description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o  maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina . Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram , criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal , reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões .

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

 

Por que essa vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência? 

O Grupo QuintoAndar está comprometido com a promoção da Inclusão Social e um dos pilares é a representatividade em nossos times. Acreditamos que através da geração de mais oportunidades e de ações intencionais, avançaremos na construção e fortalecimento da inclusão social em nosso ambiente.

Vale ressaltar que para essa vaga o nosso processo seletivo não sofreu alterações de etapas ou formas de avaliação. Entendemos que o recrutamento é uma porta de entrada para a diversidade, sempre atentos ao que nos torna plurais.

 

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

Atuamos no modelo remote-first , oferecendo total flexibilidade para você trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

title: Research Lead, Evaluations and Benchmarks
description:
Description
You ship a benchmark every two to three weeks (example benchmark). Each one measures a frontier risk that nobody has measured yet. Some go public. Some go only to the labs.
Some of the benchmarks and papers are done in collaboration with the leading AI Labs and universities.
You will not write every eval yourself. Each benchmark pairs you with an in-house researcher who owns that harm area, and you get a budget for freelancers you direct. You own the taxonomy, the harness, the quality bar and the release.
The seat sits in the CTO office alongside the research lead who sets our public research agenda. Around 150 researchers here work on harms directly, and you can pull any of them onto a subject.
Key Responsibilities
1. Ship the benchmark cadence
A benchmark every two to three weeks. Size follows the subject. A chat-based taxonomy can carry 100 evals. An agentic or GRPO benchmark is closer to 20, because each one is expensive to read. Sensitivity decides what ships publicly and what goes to the labs alone.
2. Own the quality bar
The test is simple. A frontier lab reruns our set and gets our numbers. The verifiers hold, the rubrics are clear, the distribution is sane, and their subject matter experts read the taxonomy and call it novel.
That means you read the evals yourself. You can screen with a model, and you still open the file, spot the item that does not match the taxonomy, and push the researcher back on it.
3. Run the process
Hold the plan and the calendar. You are the person who keeps other researchers on timeline. You can direct two or three freelancers (SMEs) yourself ad-hoc when needed.
4. Set the roadmap with the forum
Roughly monthly you sit with the CTO and the pod and research leads. Inputs are what our research teams see, what clients are asking for, and what is moving in the news. Output is a revised release plan for the quarter, tied to the accounts we want to open.
5. Stay ahead of the curve
Around 20% of your time goes to the ecosystem. Read the research, keep contacts inside the labs, ask them what is bothering them, and travel to a couple of conferences a year. You should be talking to folks from the labs weekly.
Requirements
Requirements

• PhD or Masters in computer science, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent depth from industry research.

• 3+ years building and running safety or security evaluations for language models in production, at an AI lab, a model provider, or a safety and security research organisation.

• 5+ relevant research publications in the field of AI safety and security including lead author on at least 2 of them

• Strong engineer. Evaluation harnesses, distributed inference, vLLM, reading a codebase and fixing it.

• You can build a taxonomy, not only score against one.

• You can direct a researcher and two freelancers without managing them formally.

• Strong English, written and spoken. This role runs on internal communication across time zones.

• Curiosity about the harms themselves. You will be learning a new subject every three weeks.

Ideally:

• Post-training experience: SFT, DPO, GRPO. Reward design for subjective and safety-relevant targets is a live problem for us.

• Agentic evaluation experience: tool use, orchestration, permissions, prompt injection.

• Publications at top conferences.

• Willingness to present your own work on a client call. Strong communication - both verbal and written, ability to present to large and/or senior audiences

• Travel to conferences at least 3 times a year

Alice clients are the top 8 AI Labs in the world.
In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platfor

• Desenvolvemos uma plataforma totalmente personalizada para que os alunos atinjam os seus objetivos. Este é, claro, o nosso principal objetivo e queremos que você também faça parte dele.

• Somos uma empresa Great Place to Work (entre as 100 melhores empresas para trabalhar em Espanha em 2023).

• Ganhámos o prémio de excelência educativa como a melhor academia online de Espanha!

• Crescemos de 4 para 62 pessoas!

Mas somos muito ambiciosos e não gostamos de nos conformar, por isso, este ano, o desafio é implementar a estratégia de expansão, abrindo escritórios na América Latina e em Portugal, e formar uma comunidade de mais de 12.000 alunos e 1.000 professores.
O que procuramos num Professor(a) de Matemática?
Procuramos alguém com grande vontade de ensinar e de se juntar ao desafio de fazer parte de uma equipa que gosta de assumir riscos, adaptar-se a mudanças e é amante da inovação.
Em poucas palavras, será responsável por ensinar e motivar os nossos alunos do Ensino Secundário no seu novo desafio: a Universidade! Se gosta de explicar, sente-se à vontade com tecnologias e é apaixonado por educação, este é o seu lugar!
A motivação e o compromisso são o nosso motor, por isso procuramos alguém que partilhe essa paixão e entusiasmo pelo que faz. É um deles?
Quais serão as suas responsabilidades?

• Criar conteúdo atualizado e de qualidade em formato digital , tanto escrito como gravado, sobre os tópicos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior. Não perdemos o foco no detalhe, por isso consideramos fundamental todas as melhorias que possam ser feitas.

• Revisar e atualizar os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior existentes na nossa plataforma. Ser eficiente está no nosso sangue e queremos que você também faça parte disso.

• Dar aulas online em direto aos alunos. Tudo o que considerar que pode funcionar para que os alunos sejam mais produtivos e gostem de estudar, será da sua responsabilidade.

• Dar apoio aos nossos alunos Ucademy nas suas dúvidas e consultas relacionadas com os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior fornecidos na plataforma, bem como correção de tarefas.

Deve ter excelentes habilidades de comunicação dinâmica , juntamente com a capacidade de priorizar tarefas e cumprir prazos estabelecidos. Será uma peça-chave no processo de seleção.
O que esperamos de si?

• Experiência prévia como Professor(a) de Matemática de Acesso ao Ensino Superior .

• Estar habituado(a) a trabalhar com plataformas tecnológicas e bases de dados.

• Experiência a gerar conteúdo digital escrito e, idealmente, conteúdo videográfico.

• Como diríamos aqui, "a atitude não é negociável" : ter proatividade é indispensável.

• Que a motivação e o bom ambiente façam parte do seu ADN, que venha para se divertir e se adapte às mudanças que temos no dia a dia.

• Valorizamos que tenha trabalhado previamente em empresas do setor de educação ou tecnologia. Assim, entenderá muito melhor todos os nossos processos!

O que oferecemos?

• Total liberdade para decidir, dar opinião e criar.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About ComPsych

ComPsych Ⓡ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResourcesⓇ and AbsenceResourcesⓇ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.
About the Role
We're modernizing how ComPsych builds technology - new customer-facing web and mobile experiences, a unified design system, and AI-powered capabilities across our products. That means raising the engineering bar for how we design, build, and operate software, with Engineering, Product, and Design working together end to end.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who has hands-on experience with modern, AI-led development practices and wants to help shape how our engineering organization builds software going forward. This is a high-leverage role: you'll spend more time on system design, task decomposition, and technical direction than on writing code line-by-line. You'll use AI tools to generate code, automated tests, and first-pass reviews, then apply your own judgment to validate and refine that output before it ships.
What You'll Do
AI changes what your time goes toward. You're still accountable for the full lifecycle - planning, design, code, tests, review, production - but your hands-on role in each shifts:

•
Plan and design as your core contribution. You own problem framing, sequencing, and tradeoffs with Product and Design, and the system design that follows - the data model, the API contracts, the failure modes.

•
Direct implementation rather than writing it line by line. Decompose the work, write the specs, and let AI agents build - dropping into the code yourself when debugging or complexity demands it.

•
Own testing as a design decision. You decide what needs coverage and at what level, direct AI to build it, and validate that the tests prove what they claim - not just that they pass.

•
Build security, reliability, and observability in from the start. They're design inputs, not production afterthoughts - the systems you ship can be operated safely and understood when they fail.

•
Review everything with the same rigor, regardless of author, and keep production judgment human. You're accountable for what ships whether you or an agent wrote it. Deployment calls, on-call response, and what an incident teaches you stay yours.

•
Raise the bar for how the team works with AI, coaching engineers to specify, delegate, and validate rather than hand-code everything themselves.

What We're Looking For

•
Deep server-side experience in a modern language such as Java, Python, C#, Kotlin, or Go. You've owned services end to end, not just features inside someone else's, and can pick up ours quickly.

•
Must have 5+ years of full stack development experience.

•
APIs and data models other people depend on: REST contracts, versioning, OAuth2/OIDC, schema design, and SQL that holds up under real load.

•
Async and event-driven systems in production - Kafka or comparable, idempotency, and a clear view of what at-least-once costs you downstream.

•
You've built and operated production systems at real scale on AWS or Azure - containers, Kubernetes or serverless, IaC, and CI/CD pipelines you've built, operated, or materially improved. You've carried the on-call load for them, so you know what “good” looks like independent of who or what wrote the code.

•
A testing strategy you can defend - what belongs at unit, integration, and contract level, and how you know a release is verifiable before it ships.

title: Utilization Review Nurse - LVN / LPN
description:
Overview
Who We Are
Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform-bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.
Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.
Responsibilities
Ready to be the clinical judgment call that keeps care on track?
Why This Role Matters
Every pre-certification, every inpatient stay, every appeal that lands on your desk is a moment where your review decides what happens next for a real person's care. This role is where clinical assessment meets real consequence, making sure treatment requests get matched to the right level of care, the right setting, and the right guidelines every single time. Get it right, and patients move through the system smoothly, providers stay aligned with plan benefits, and the organization avoids unnecessary cost and risk. Get it wrong, or get it slow, and care gets delayed or denied when it shouldn't be. Your accuracy and pace are what keep the entire utilization review process trustworthy.
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time, with rotating weekends coverage as required.
What You'll Actually Do

•
Own first-level reviews: Assess outpatient, ancillary, and inpatient pre-certification requests, including mental health, substance abuse, skilled nursing, and rehab stays, for medical appropriateness and necessity.

•
Drive post-service reviews: Evaluate post-claim and post-service requests against clinical guidelines to confirm medical necessity after the fact.

•
Escalate the right cases: Route denial authorizations to the Medical Director and, when required, through Independent Review Organizations (IRO), and refer out-of-guideline requests to advance review or senior care consultants.

•
Coordinate smooth discharges: Work directly with hospital staff to prepare patients for discharge and set up a clean transition to the next level of care.

•
Manage the appeals process: Process appeals for non-certified services and complete non-certification letters accurately and on time.

•
Redirect care in-network: Review plan documents for benefit determinations and steer providers and patients toward PPO options whenever possible.

•
Connect patients to the right program: Identify and refer cases to case management, wellness, chronic disease, and Nurturing Together programs when clinical needs point that way.

•
Document every review: Complete accurate, timely documentation in Eldorado/Episodes for every case, maintaining strict confidentiality throughout.

•
Apply the right criteria: Use MCG guidelines, medical policies, Medscape, and NCCN to ground every determination in evidence-based standards.

•
Hit the bar, every time: Meet daily productivity, quality, and turnaround-time standards, and support department operations and new initiatives as they roll out.

Qualifications
What You Bring to Our Team
Education & Experience:

• Current LVN license in the United States or a U.S. territory

• 1+ years of clinical experience

Technical Skills:

• Working knowledge of medical claims and ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding

• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

• Familiarity with MCG guidelines, NCCN criteria, and Medscape

• Experience documenting reviews in utilization management systems (e.g., Eldorado/Episodes)

Benefits
The Highlights:

• Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one

• Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)

• Paid Time Off-rest and recharge time is non-negotiable

• Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection

• Professional development with clear career progress

description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with multi-axis CNC programming, machining strategies, tooling selection, blueprint interpretation, and precision manufacturing processes in a fast-paced production environment.

Hourly Pay Rate: $45.00 -$55.00/hr

$10,000 sign on bonus to assist with relocation.

Work Schedule

• Standard: Monday-Thursday (4x10 schedule aligned with AST operations)

What you'll do:

Machine Programmer /Operation & Setup

• Perform machine setup including tooling, fixtures, offsets, and work holding

Production & Quality

• Interpret blueprints, GD&T, technical drawings, and work instructions

• Ensure parts meet strict aerospace tolerances and quality standards

• Document and report non-conforming parts per quality procedures

Process Control & Troubleshooting

• Identify machining issues (tool wear, chatter, offsets) and implement corrective actions

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization

Maintenance & Safety

The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

About the Programme

EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production.

EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers.

The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems.

The Role

Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold.

The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change - so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next.

This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops.

Responsibilities

• Reliability targets - set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads

• Observability and detection - define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging; require an automated path from a firing alert to the affected services and their owners; and hold the operating teams to closing the logging gaps in what runs today

• The incident and change path - set the runbook standard and its required coverage, extend incident classification and intervention mechanisms to agentic failure modes, and have rollback and change-failure rates measured and reported by those who own them

• Capacity and performance - direct the headroom position through the parallel-run peak at cutover, sponsor the chaos and game-day programme for payment rails and the core ledger, and mandate that capacity modelling covers inference workloads

• Gate evidence - own the technical content of the Operational Acceptance Report and Operational Readiness Certificate, the reliability section of each gate pack, and the reliability NFRs defended as ADRs through the client's Architecture Design Authority - written by the teams, reviewed and signed off by you

• The operating organisation - decide how responsibilities sit between the client's teams and its managed service providers for the new platform, and lead the people concerned through that change

Expected experience

• 10+ years in leading IT operations teams - You have operated L1, L2, and L3 support as SRE, platform reliability or infrastructure organisations, with the people and the providers reporting to you

• Has introduced SLOs and error budgets into an organisation that did not have them, and can build on the experienced success factors

• Infrastructure in depth - has deep infrastructure knowledge, and what is required for smooth business operations: telemetry, redundancies, backups, etc.

You'll be joining the Simulation team (Simulation Evaluation & Validation), working on Gaia - Wayve's world model. Gaia is trained on large-scale driving video to predict future frames from past context, functioning as a simulator that generates synthetic scenarios and operates in closed loop with the driving model itself. title: Software Engineer
description:
About VALIS

We’re a fast-moving, rapidly growing B2B SaaS company focused on bringing modern technology to the metal recycling industry - an essential but underserved market segment. Our technology helps recyclers close more deals, operate more efficiently, and finally ditch the pen-and-paper workflows.
We’re an early-stage company, backed by leading climate-tech VCs, looking to bring on new team members that can help us build VALIS and transform the industry. We lead with authenticity, boldness, passion, and empathy focused on creating a more sustainable future. A career at VALIS is one where you’ll be empowered to expand your technical and leadership abilities while having a positive impact on the world.
The role
As a Software Engineer at VALIS , you'll build and scale our newest product line, taking it from a blank page to the plant floor. You'll spend time with operators and plant managers, design the schema and application, and deliver a product that scrap processors rely on to run their plant. Working directly with our CTO, product team, and end users, you'll make the architecture and design decisions, prioritize what gets built when, and see your work used every shift, every day. We're hiring across mid-senior levels, from a few years experience to senior engineers.
What you'll do

• Own the product end-to-end: data model, API, UI, UX, deployment, and iteration.

• Design a multi-tenant domain model (materials, loads, runs, equipment, quality) that holds up as each customer's process differs.

• Build fast, robust, validated data-entry workflows for the plant floor.

• Deliver insights dashboards managers act on each shift.

• Meet with operators and facility managers weekly, get on-site, and turn what you see into product decisions.

• Integrate new data sources with existing VALIS data and customer systems such as ERP exports, scales, and plant controls.

• Build and deploy agentic features to surface trends from production and quality data, flag anomalies, and notify the right people.

How we work

•
Remote, US-based. Work from anywhere in the US, overlapping with East Coast business hours (roughly 9am to 5pm ET).

•
Small team, low overhead. You'll work directly with our CTO, along with a product and business team with deep industry experience.

•
Our stack: React and TypeScript on the frontend; C# and ASP.NET Core with PostgreSQL on the backend; AWS, Docker, and Pulumi for infrastructure.

•
We use Claude Code heavily and expect you to be highly effective with it. You should own and understand the code you ship; AI speeds up the work but does not replace the thinking.

•
Travel a few times a year for customer site visits and company get-togethers (on-site at our HQ in Worcester, MA or off-site elsewhere).

Requirements
Who you are
We hire for fundamentals & mindset. You:

• Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience (for senior candidates, 5+ and have led technical projects).

• Think data model first: you can turn a messy real-world process into a clean, normalized schema... and defend the tradeoff decisions.

• Use types, clear boundaries, and domain language to make wrong states hard to represent.

• Are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, finding solutions without waiting for instruction.

• Are solid across databases, backend APIs, and frontend fundamentals.

• Are mathematically minded, with strong quantitative and statistical fundamentals, so the numbers we show customers are ones they can trust.

• Move fast, cut scope wisely, and don't shy away from talking to customers.

• Write and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical team members (we're a remote team).

It won't be a good fit if you want a big team to lean on, a slow/low-risk release process, or narrow-scoped work.
If this role really excites you, but you don't check all the boxes, apply anyway!
Bonus points

• Familiarity with our stack (React, TypeScript, C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, AWS).

The Okta Secures AI Team

The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. By architecting solutions that move beyond reactive perimeter security, you will empower organizations to prevent "Shadow AI" and transform AI risk into business ROI.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. You will rethink backend design, validation, and delivery through AI-augmented workflows, ensuring our platform provides secure, interoperable, and scalable access-enforcing the principle of least privilege for every agent action.

title: Construction Superintendent, Electrical - Memphis
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

CONSTRUCTION SUPERINTENDENT, ELECTRICAL

Most construction jobs manage someone else’s crew on someone else’s schedule, then end when the project does. This one does not.

SpaceX builds its own launch sites, factories, test stands, and AI superclusters - and it plans to keep building. The rockets, the chips, and the missions only matter if the ground under them is real. Construction is how that ground gets built, in-house and to a standard the company can actually use. The work does not dry up between jobs. There is a next site, and one after that. You lead the crew that builds them.

You own a self-performing team. Foremen run their people day to day. You run the foremen. You are in the dirt, walking the work, setting the bar, and clearing whatever is in the way. When someone is ready for more, you say so. When the standard slips, you deal with it. Scope includes, but not limited to underground duct banks, high-voltage and medium-voltage systems, power distribution, grounding, lighting, and process power for mission-critical facilities.

The team goes where the next site is - a pad, a factory, a supercluster, whatever has to exist before the rest of the company can move. Right now that is Memphis, TN / Southaven, MS. Then it is the next one. Per diem comes with the assignment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Directly oversee foremen and, through them, a large self-perform electrical crew installing underground duct banks, conduits, cable, terminations, switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, PDUs, and grounding

• Set clear expectations for safety, quality, schedule, and conduct, and hold foremen and crews accountable when those expectations are missed

• Remove roadblocks so crews can keep working: materials, access, sequencing, coordination with other trades, and decisions

• Recommend promotions, role changes, and corrective action based on performance

• Plan and run the night-shift assignment, including extended hours, as part of a 24/7 operation

• Keep electrical installations on SpaceXSI’s quality and reliability standards, including code compliance and system integrity required for data center uptime

• Track daily progress and maintain logs, red-line drawings, and as-built documentation for power infrastructure

• Build and hold an aggressive construction schedule, on time and within budget

• Champion SpaceXSI’s safety program and a zero-incident culture around energized equipment, excavations, and heavy electrical work

• Resolve on-site issues - material delays, technical conflicts, sequencing, and trade coordination - with attention to reliability and code compliance

• Inspect work for compliance with local regulations, electrical codes, safety protocols, and SpaceXSI quality standards

• Report progress, electrical construction metrics, and risks to senior leadership

• Relocate with the mobile team as assignments change, starting in Memphis, TN / Southaven, MS

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 3+ years leading electrical construction teams, including supervision of foremen

• 3+ years of direct hands-on experience in electrical installations, including underground duct bank

title: Browser Vulnerability Researcher
description:
CENSUS is an internationally acclaimed Cybersecurity services provider. We support the needs of multiple industries, providing IT and OT security assessment services to public and private organizations around the world, including international financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies. Powered by cutting-edge research, scientific analysis, and real-world engineering, we deliver unparalleled security assessment services for software, devices, infrastructure, and organizations. Learn more about CENSUS at census-labs.com.

About the Role

CENSUS is looking for a Vulnerability Researcher specializing in modern web browsers and browser exploitation.

The role focuses on identifying, analyzing, and demonstrating security vulnerabilities in complex browser components such as rendering engines, JavaScript engines, IPC systems, sandboxing mechanisms, and platform integrations.

Responsibilities

• Research security vulnerabilities in modern browsers such as Firefox, Chromium-based and WebKit-based browsers.

• Perform source-code auditing of large C/C++ codebases to identify memory-safety, logic, sandbox, and privilege-boundary vulnerabilities.

• Investigate JavaScript engine internals such as V8, SpiderMonkey, or JavaScriptCore.

• Analyze browser sandbox boundaries and investigate sandbox escape vulnerabilities.

• Reverse engineer browser binaries and security-relevant operating-system components.

• Debug crashes and memory-corruption issues using tools such as WinDbg, GDB, LLDB, AddressSanitizer, and related tooling.

• Develop fuzzers, harnesses, and automation for vulnerability discovery.

• Study exploit mitigations such as ASLR, DEP/NX, Control Flow Guard, CET, CFI, MTE/MIE, pointer authentication, and sandboxing.

• Develop proof-of-concept exploits to validate vulnerabilities and understand their practical impact.

• Produce clear technical reports describing vulnerability root cause, exploitability and affected components.

Required Skills

• Strong knowledge of C/C++ and x64/aarch64 assembly.

• Excellent understanding of memory management, pointers, object lifetime, and concurrency.

• Strong knowledge of operating-system internals, particulary Android and iOS.

• Experience with reverse engineering tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, or similar.

• Familiarity with browser architecture and multi-process sandbox designs.

• Experience analyzing large codebases.

• Knowledge of common memory-corruption vulnerability classes and exploitation techniques.

• Familiarity with debugging and sanitization tools such as ASan, UBSan, WinDbg, GDB, or LLDB.

• Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems and document findings clearly.

Preferred Skills

Experience researching Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

Experience developing browser exploits or participating in vulnerability disclosure / bug-bounty programs.

Experience with coverage-guided fuzzing tools such as libFuzzer, AFL++, or custom fuzzing frameworks.

Familiarity with modern exploit-development techniques including heap manipulation, arbitrary read/write primitives, information leaks, and control-flow manipulation.

Knowledge of compiler-generated mitigations and browser hardening mechanisms.

🎂 Birthday Paid Day off
